messages.subject: [DirichletReg-News] DirichletReg 0.6-0 on R-Forge
messages.body_plain:
Dear DirichletReg Users,

A new version of DirichletReg (0.6-0) is available on R-Forge and it
features some nice enhancements (speedy C-code) as well as convenient
functions such as drop1() to ease (backward) model selection.

For more details, please see the News-Post on R-Forge:
http://r-forge.r-project.org/forum/forum.php?forum_id=4469

The package available for Linux and Windows (Macs unfortunately have to
compile it from source) via:
> install.packages("DirichletReg", repos="http://r-forge.r-project.org")

Kind regards,
Marco
